summary: Full end-to-end testing of the admin-controllable app-download / custom-offer popup. Admin login worked, the 'Pop-up & app downloads' pane rendered with all required data-testids, switching to Custom mode + saving persisted correctly (verified via GET /api/settings/public), the public homepage popup rendered custom content with the custom CTA (correct label + href) and no app-store buttons and no floating dock, disabling the master toggle prevented both the popup and the dock on the public site, and re-enabling with app mode restored the app-store popup + dock. Cleanup restored defaults (enabled=true, mode=app, all custom fields blank).

issues: Minor UX: title/description/eyebrow/cta fields written while in Custom mode are NOT cleared or hidden when the admin switches back to App mode. They remain saved and, because AppDownloads.jsx falls back to settings.download_popup_title || <default>, the app-mode popup then shows the leftover custom title instead of 'Take Tony Yoga with you.'. Suggest either (a) hiding/clearing custom fields on mode switch server-side, or (b) applying custom-mode fields only when mode==='custom' in the frontend fallback logic.

action_items: Optional polish: in AppDownloads.jsx, only use download_popup_title/description/eyebrow/image when mode === 'custom' (currently they leak into app mode if set previously).
critical_code_review_comments: AppDownloads.jsx line 66-72: fallbacks read custom copy regardless of mode, causing leftover custom text to appear in app-mode popup after mode switch. Gate these behind mode === 'custom'.
AppDownloadsSettings.jsx: when the user changes mode back to 'app', consider clearing/hiding the custom fields client-side so persistence surprises don't happen.
seed_data_creation: None (settings were mutated during test and fully restored to defaults at cleanup)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Popup component sets sessionStorage 'ty_download_invited' after showing; use fresh browser context (as done here) or clear sessionStorage before dispatching 'tony-open-downloads'. Popup gates on eligible pages – excludes /admin, /instructor, /login, /checkout etc., so trigger from '/'.  Data-testids present and stable.
